targets.query:
from(bucket: "sensores")
  |> range(start: -15m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "valor" and r.cliente == "${cliente}")
  |> keep(columns: ["sensor"])
  |> group()
  |> unique(column: "sensor")
  |> count(column: "sensor")

panels.title: Lecturas de temperatura en el rango

targets.query:
from(bucket: "sensores")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "temperatura" and r._field == "valor" and r.cliente == "${cliente}" and contains(value: r.sensor, set: ${sensor:json}))
  |> group()
  |> count()

panels.title: Última lectura por sensor y magnitud

targets.query:
from(bucket: "sensores")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "valor" and r.cliente == "${cliente}" and contains(value: r.sensor, set: ${sensor:json}))
  |> group(columns: ["sensor", "_measurement", "unidad"])
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> keep(columns: ["sensor", "_measurement", "_value", "unidad", "_time"])
  |> rename(columns: {sensor: "Sensor", _measurement: "Magnitud", _value: "Valor", unidad: "Unidad", _time: "Última lectura (UTC)"})
  |> sort(columns: ["Sensor", "Magnitud"])
